items.title: Actual compact weak Poisson: one smooth function/gradient/Laplacian sequence

Authored compact ordinary-volume smooth graph approximation, not a quoted numbered theorem.

items.statement: From the exact compact-supported volumeL2 and original weak-gradient/PDE inputs, Derive one real Schwartz sequence phi_n with one common outer compact Kprime containing every tsupport(phi_n), chosen before all n and all three limits. Actual volumeL2 classes of phi_n converge to v; actual classical gradient(phi_n) is MemLp2 and its class converges to the original G; actual Laplacian(phi_n) classes converge to F. Every phi_n is C-infinity and compactly supported. The same sequence realizes all limits. Kprime need not equal K. No classical derivatives of rough v, real Hessian family, quantitative source complexity constant or weighted operator core is claimed.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel space E with canonical ordinary full-space volume, including dimension zero. Real pointwise v,F and vector G are genuinely global volumeL2; their topological supports lie in the same compact K.

Every real C1 compact test psi and every a satisfies both L1 products and integral psi*inner(G,a)=-integral v*D_a psi. Every real C2 compact psi has both L1 products and integral v*Delta psi=integral F*psi. These actual weak equations, measurability/L2 and supports are inputs; graph density, Sobolev membership, smooth sequence, real mixed Hessian and weighted core are not supplied.

The rough v/G/F representatives are differentiated only in the actual weak/distributional sense. Classical gradients and Laplacians in the conclusion belong to actual smooth approximants. SchwartzMap E real is genuinely C-infinity/rapidly decaying; common compact support is additionally derived. No positive dimension, jointly measurable selector, source C-infinity potential or normalized plateau is assumed.

formulae.label: Actual compact weak Poisson: one smooth function/gradient/Laplacian sequence
formulae.tex: \int\psi\langle G,a\rangle=-\int vD_a\psi,\quad\int v\Delta\psi=\int F\psi\ \Longrightarrow\ \exists K\prime,\varphi_n\in C_c^\infty(K\prime):\quad\varphi_n\to v,\ \nabla\varphi_n\to G,\ \Delta\varphi_n\to F\ \text{in }L^2(dx).
